stem: A pharmacist discovers a dispensing error while the patient may still be exposed to harm. Which duties apply? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Immediately notify the patient or representative and give correction and harm-minimization directions.
Finish root-cause analysis before contacting the patient.
Always notify the patient before the prescriber in a strict sequence.
Immediately notify the prescriber when professional judgment indicates it is warranted.
Complete the initial QRE documentation within 24 hours after discovery or notification.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supported conclusions on these facts are: Immediately notify the patient or representative and give correction and harm-minimization directions. Immediately notify the prescriber when professional judgment indicates it is warranted. Complete the initial QRE documentation within 24 hours after discovery or notification.

choice_analysis.A: Supported: Immediately notify the patient or representative and give correction and harm-minimization directions.
choice_analysis.B: Not supported: Finish root-cause analysis before contacting the patient.
choice_analysis.C: Not supported: Always notify the patient before the prescriber in a strict sequence.
choice_analysis.D: Supported: Immediately notify the prescriber when professional judgment indicates it is warranted.
choice_analysis.E: Supported: Complete the initial QRE documentation within 24 hours after discovery or notification.

related_facts: On discovery of a quality-related event, the pharmacist must immediately notify the patient or representative, notify the prescriber when professionally indicated, and give corrective and harm-minimization directions.
The pharmacist who discovers or receives notice of a quality-related event must initially document it within 24 hours after discovery or notification.
explanation.mpje_trap: Distinguish this near-miss from the controlling rule: 'Finish root-cause analysis before contacting the patient.'

reasoning_steps: Match the scenario's operative facts to Immediate response after discovery of a quality-related event
Reject nearby rules whose schedule, trigger, deadline, or actor differs from QRE notification
Confirm the exception, documentation, and timing conditions against the cited official authority
